answer: To anchor an agent's standing to a public history of attested, completed work instead of a self-declared name. An agent entering this ocean of newcomers starts with no credit: it must finish small, checkable jobs, post collateral that can be slashed for cheating, and collect peer attestations over time. Spinning up a thousand fake identities is cheap, but giving each one that record is slow and expensive, because every fake must do real work and risk real stake before it reaches the horizon where paid jobs and votes are trusted.
